data.name: Jabina
data.gender_notes: Jabina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who embodies grace, gentleness, and beauty. She is a joy to be around and is often sought after for her calm demeanor and kind nature. The name Jabina carries the meaning “Graceful and gentle woman” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jabina usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and gentle woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle touch of God in a woman's life.
data.etymology: Jabina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful and gentle woman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jabina total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: جابينا
in_arabic.meaning: جابينا تعني الفتاة التي ترفع رأسها بفخر و عزة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جابينا مشتق من الجذر العربي ج-ب-ن، ويعني الفتاة التي ترفع رأسها بفخر و عزة، و قد ورد ذكره في بعض الأحاديث النبوية، و هو اسم ذو معنى جميل و رفيع، يدل على الصفات الحميدة و الأخلاق الرفيعة

in_urdu.name: جابینا
in_urdu.meaning: جابینا یعنی وہ لڑکی جو فخر اور عزت کے ساتھ اپنا سر بلند رکھتی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: جابینا نام عربی جذر ج-ب-ن سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ لڑکی جو فخر اور عزت کے ساتھ اپنا سر بلند رکھتی ہے، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں مذکور ہے، اور یہ ایک خوبصورت اور بلند معانی والا نام ہے جو اچھی صفات اور عالی شان اخلاق کی دلالت کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: जाबिना
in_hindi.meaning: जाबिना यानी वह लड़की जो गर्व और सम्मान के साथ अपना सिर ऊंचा रखती है
in_hindi.long_meaning: जाबिना नाम अरबी जड़ ज-ب-न से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है वह लड़की जो गर्व और सम्मान के साथ अपना सिर ऊंचा रखती है, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है, और यह एक सुंदर और उच्च अर्थ वाला नाम है जो अच्छे गुणों और उच्च नैतिकता को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: جابينا
in_pashto.meaning: جابينا ياني هغه نجلۍ چې د فخر او عزت سره يې سر لوړ ساتي
in_pashto.long_meaning: جابينا نوم د عربي جذر ج-ب-ن څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې هغه نجلۍ چې د فخر او عزت سره يې سر لوړ ساتي، دا نوم په اسلامي دود کې مهم دی، او دا يو ښکلی او لوړ معنی لرونکی نوم دی چې د ښو صفاتو او لوړ اخلاقو دلالت کوي

in_english.long_meaning: The name Jabina is derived from the Arabic root j-b-n, meaning a girl who holds her head high with pride and dignity, it has been mentioned in some prophetic traditions, and is a name with a beautiful and lofty meaning, indicating good qualities and high morals, and has been used across various Muslim cultures

data.cultural_impact: The name Jabina holds great cultural significance in the Islamic community as it implies a woman who embodies wonderful qualities that are admired and appreciated. The name evokes images of elegance, grace, and beauty which is a valued trait in Islamic culture. The character and demeanor of a woman named Jabina illuminates the essence of womanhood as being gentle, kind, and joyful, which is emphasized and celebrated in many Islamic societies.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Jabina lies in the fact that it represents the embodiment of excellent character traits that are sought after in Islam. The name Jabina signifies a woman who embodies the qualities of kindness, gentleness, and beauty - traits that are highly desirable in Islamic teachings. The spiritual significance of the name is a reminder to strive to attain these God-pleasing traits and to treat others with love, kindness, and respect. It is a reminder of the importance of grace and beauty both in one's outer appearance and in one's inner character.
